limits: GPU evidence exists only after caller execution. Source colours are raw packed numeric values, not tone-mapped images or camera-visible source extraction.
Numerical oracle is independent Laplace integration of isotropic Gaussian average, not a reuse of production shader/CPU special functions.
Declared.002 special-function budget is tested at centres, small-z, piece boundaries and far limits; this sampled fixture is not a universal formal floating-point proof.
RGBA32F coefficients are read through an owned detached target; no draw samples an attached output texture. Numeric textures must not mipmap.
Volume fixtures isolate stable indices, world rd, alpha and P. They are not actual-island visual acceptance, joint source/view self-shadowing or full anisotropic RTE.
Performance query covers isolated bake only. Stress escalates only with valid actual GPU time and predicted<40ms, stops after actual50ms; never infers island FPS from this.
